The City is giving $34,000 to Culture Montréal to produce season 4 of the podcast "Francophiles dans la ville."
The money comes from the $1,250,000 agreement between the City and the ministère de la Langue française; the cost is covered by the central city.
The podcast features interviews by Julie Laferrière during walks through Montréal neighbourhoods, with guests born outside Québec who are finishing their French-language learning.
The 2026 season will come with teaching tools and workshops to spark discussion around the themes covered.
Planned schedule: recording in February, post-production in March, release in April and May, final report in June and July.
An agreement between the City and the organization sets the payment conditions and includes a visibility protocol.
The City is giving $188,114 to organizations to hold 22 sporting events in Montréal in 2026.

The money comes from the second and final call for projects under the Programme de soutien aux événements sportifs internationaux, nationaux et métropolitains, which had a total budget of $450,000 for 2026.
The largest amounts go to triathlon (Série Para World Triathlon and Coupe Americas, $20,000), short track speed skating ($18,000) and handball ($15,000).
Five metropolitan events are supported, including the Course Nocturne Sun Life ($12,371), the Triathlon de Verdun ($12,000) and the Festival des bateaux-dragons chinois ($3,431).
Each organization receives 80% of the amount as soon as the decision is adopted and 20% after submitting its final report.
Of the 24 applications received, 2 were turned down: one because its level of sanctioning was not high enough, the other because its local roots and reach were considered limited.
The cost is paid entirely by the Montréal urban agglomeration.

The City is transferring $10,555,000 from its capital works budget to the borough of Saint-Léonard in 2026 to finish building a soccer field covered by a permanent inflatable structure (dome) at parc Hébert.
The money comes from two central programs: $7,017,000 from the program to bring supra-local sports facilities up to standard, and $3,538,000 from the aquatic facilities program.
The project aims to provide a synthetic soccer field that can be used 12 months a year, to make up for the shortage of sports surfaces in winter and to meet the needs of regional leagues.
Through an agreement with the Service de la culture, des sports et des loisirs, Saint-Léonard is committing to provide the service offer for regional sports activities and to follow set terms of use.
The work was awarded in August 2025 to CHAREX INC. for $15,166,593.54, including contingencies and incidental costs.
The total cost of the project is estimated at $15,225,000 gross, of which $2,799,000 is covered by a grant from the federal-provincial PAFIRS program.
According to the document, this transfer has no impact on the City's financial framework.
The borough of Rosemont–La Petite-Patrie is tabling its 2025 annual report on housing projects authorized despite urban planning rules, under section 93 of Québec's housing act.
Three projects received such an authorization in 2025 and no application was refused.

The projects involved: blocks 5 and 7 of the Îlot central of the Technopôle Angus (residential and commercial), 32 social and community housing units at 3505, rue Bagot, and a six-storey building with 48 housing units and one commercial space at 5625, avenue Papineau.
The report must be tabled no later than April 1 following the year covered, which is March 9, 2026 in this case.
The Service de l'habitation will send the report to the minister responsible for housing, and the information will be published on the City's website.
The borough of Rosemont–La Petite-Patrie is authorizing the construction of a 5-storey mixed-use building at 2570, boulevard Rosemont, on a triangular lot between rue Molson and rue des Carrières.

The building would hold 15 housing units for young women coming out of youth centres, above premises for the Bureau de la communauté haïtienne de Montréal, shared spaces for other organizations, and a multi-purpose room.
A food distribution organization would occupy part of the ground floor, with a loading area; no car parking spaces are planned, but there would be 36 bicycle spaces, 28 of them indoors.

The City is granting several exemptions from its regulations: a height of 20 m and 5 storeys instead of 12.5 m and 3 storeys, no green roof, shared main entrances, community uses and businesses on the 2nd floor, and a non-compliant loading area.

Conditions imposed: a permit application within 60 months, the delivery truck parked within the lot, and an architectural review (treatment of the façades, the entrance, the rooftop mechanical room, and the rain garden).
The building currently vacant on the lot must be demolished for safety reasons; gardens, rooftop vegetable gardens and rain gardens are planned.
This is a second draft resolution: a public consultation is planned and the project may be subject to approval by referendum.
The borough of Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension is paying $147,904.70 to two Parc-Extension organizations to help them pay for their new premises, from April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2028.
Ressource Action-Alimentation Parc-Extension is receiving $77,414 ($46,355.69 in 2026-2027 and $31,058.31 in 2027-2028); it rents two offices at 7000, avenue du Parc.
Le Centre haïtien d'animation et d'interventions sociales (CHAIS) is receiving $70,490.70 ($42,210 in 2026-2027 and $28,280.70 in 2027-2028); it occupies two offices at 7200, rue Hutchison.

Both organizations had to leave the Complexe William-Hingston, where the City had been renting space from the school service centre since 1994; the lease ended on June 30, 2025 with no possibility of renewal.
The funding decreases over time, includes taxes, and cannot be extended after March 2028; the organizations will have to report on how the money is used.
The borough's director of culture, sports, recreation and social development is authorized to sign the agreements on behalf of the City.
The organizations' new addresses will be updated on montreal.ca.

The borough of Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension is awarding a contract without a call for tenders, worth $212,703 including taxes, to Corporation de Gestion des loisirs du Parc, a non-profit organization.
The organization will handle reception, supervision, management of the premises and maintenance at the Complexe William-Hingston, in Parc-Extension.
The contract runs from July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027, that is, one year.
The complex belongs to the Centre de services scolaire de Montréal and is rented by the borough, which has occupied only part of the ground floor since the lease took effect on July 1, 2025.
That portion houses a municipal library, the Maison de la culture de Parc-Extension, a community organization, an indoor pool, gyms and a palestra.
The previous contract, for 2025-2026, was $298,462 and also covered the chalet Jean-Paul II.
The expense is paid out of the department's operating budget; the 2027 funds depend on the approval of that year's budget.

The borough of Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension is entrusting the operation of the chalet Jean-Paul II, in the Parc-Extension district, to the Corporation de Gestion des loisirs du Parc, a non-profit organization.
The contract, awarded by mutual agreement, is worth a maximum of $448,403 including taxes, from July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029.
The organization will handle reception, supervision, management of the premises and maintenance of common areas.

The chalet hosts organizations and services transferred after the relocation of the Complexe William-Hingston; these organizations use the gyms, the exercise room and the multi-purpose rooms free of charge.
The previous contract, for the Complexe William-Hingston and the chalet Jean-Paul II, was $298,462 for one year (July 2025 to June 2026).
The expense is paid out of the regular budget of the department; the funds for 2027, 2028 and 2029 depend on the approval of the annual budgets.
The borough's director of culture, sports, recreation and social development is authorized to sign the agreement.

The borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce is proposing to take charge itself of the design, supervision and completion of work that falls under the central city, on avenue Coolbrook between avenue Isabella and chemin Queen-Mary.

The planned work: replacing the sewer and water mains, replacing lead service lines (including the portion on private property), and work on the traffic lights at the Queen-Mary/Coolbrook intersection.

The roadway and sidewalks will be rebuilt across the full width and length of the section, with wider sidewalks, planted curb extensions at intersections, and the addition of water-absorbing infrastructure where possible.
The document points to the advanced deterioration of the pipes, the roadway and the sidewalks, and to the fact that the pipes have reached the end of their useful life.

No amount is given: the Direction de la gestion des actifs (Service de l'eau) is paying for the pipes and the lead service lines; the sidewalks and roadway are shared between that department, the borough and the Service des infrastructures du réseau routier.

The borough could request funding from two programs (making school surroundings safer, and redevelopment of arterial streets) if they are renewed in 2026; otherwise it will assess whether it pays for this work itself.
Announced timeline: plans and specifications from July to December 2026, call for tenders in December 2026, contract in February–March 2027, and work from May to October 2027.

The borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce is adding $332,953.73, taxes included, to the fees of the firm Studio Affleck de la Riva (formerly Affleck de la Riva Architectes) for the chalet in parc Loyola.
The authorized spending for this professional services contract therefore rises from $391,604.85 to $724,558.58, taxes and incidental costs included.
The increase breaks down into $316,377.67 in additional fees and $16,576.03 added to the contingency budget.
The adjustment stems from the contract: the fees follow the cost of the project, which went from an initial budget of $2,000,000 (2021) to a bid of $4,227,985 (August 2025), before taxes.
The firm designed the project and issued the call for tenders; it will oversee the work site until the end of the warranty period.
The work to enlarge, redevelop and renovate the chalet is planned from the winter of 2026 to the summer of 2027; signs will be put up on the work site fence.
The net increase of $304,031.13 will be paid for out of the parks fund.
The Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce borough is approving the transfer of five architecture contracts from the firm Affleck de la Riva S.E.N.C. to the new company Studio Affleck de la Riva inc.
The two partners, Gavin Affleck and Richard de la Riva, decided to carry on their activities through a recently incorporated company, which made the transfer necessary.

The contracts involved cover the plans, specifications and construction supervision for the centre Le Manoir, the roof of the aréna Bill-Durnan, the chalet in parc Loyola, the centre communautaire Notre-Dame-de-Grâce and the centre sportif Trenholme.
The same terms apply: according to the document, the transfer has no budget impact for the City and the project timelines remain unchanged.
The new firm takes over all rights and obligations from the start of the contracts; both firms remain jointly and severally liable for past errors or omissions.
The agreement takes effect on January 1, 2026, and any future transfer will require a new written agreement from the City.

The borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce is awarding Ad Hoc Architectes inc. a professional services contract worth $458,750.25, taxes included, for the Théâtre Empress (formerly Cinéma V), at 5560, rue Sherbrooke Ouest.

The mandate covers keeping the two neo-Egyptian style façades and demolishing the rest of the building, which has been vacant since a fire in 1992, in order to create a temporary outdoor public square.
The services cover architecture, engineering, landscape architecture, decontamination of the site, demolition permits and a mobility plan during and after the work.

The total authorized spending comes to $573,437.81, taxes included, that is, the contract plus $68,812.54 in contingencies and $45,875.03 in incidental expenses (soil tests, decontamination monitoring, given to other firms).
Only two firms submitted bids out of 13 that picked up the tender documents; the other bid, from STGM Architecture inc., was $929,110.10.
The price chosen is $177,061.50 (62.7%) higher than the last administrative estimate; the borough points to the market, the presence of contaminants and the condition of the façades.
The file will be paid for out of allocated surpluses: $426,878.22 for the project and $96,749.78 for the CELO.
The borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce is approving an additional expense of $235,982.06, taxes included, for work at the Centre Le Manoir.
The money goes to Construction Irénée Paquet & Fils inc., which was awarded the contract to redevelop, renovate and bring the building up to code in May 2024.
The reserve for unforeseen site costs goes from $674,234.44 to $910,216.50, that is, from 10% to 13.5% of the contract value.
The total cost of the project reaches $7,854,831.27, compared with $7,618,849.21 approved at the outset.

The unforeseen items cited: asbestos, lead paint, mould, cotton-insulated electrical wiring to be replaced, a raised floor not identified before the work began, and the foundations of the outdoor staircases.
The expense, $215,483.07 net of rebates, will be paid out of the borough's unallocated surplus.
The work is to be completed by July 31, 2026; the scope of the project remains the same.
The borough of Saint-Léonard is submitting its annual report on two money reserves: the one for parks and playgrounds, and the one for parking space exemptions, for the year 2025.
The parks reserve went from $1,538,910.93 on January 1, 2025 to $1,618,724.22 on December 31, 2025.
A contribution of $761,330.13 was collected into this reserve in 2025.
$291,687.55 was used to build a new dog park north of rue J-B Martineau.
An accounting adjustment of $389,829.29 corresponds to amounts not used for ongoing projects, which will be reallocated in 2026.
The reserve tied to exemptions from providing parking spaces stayed at $183,127.16, with no movement in 2025.
This type of report stems from a recommendation made by the Vérificateur général in February 2019.

The City is giving 236 documents (books, periodicals and audiovisual materials) removed from the collections of the Bibliothèque du Jardin botanique de Montréal to Amis du Jardin botanique, a non-profit organization.
These are documents that are out of date, damaged or rarely borrowed; the library wants to keep its collections current and free up storage space.
Amis du Jardin botanique will resell these documents at a low price during fundraising events held at the Jardin botanique.

Each document sold will carry the notice "Retiré des collections de la bibliothèque du Jardin botanique de Montréal" (removed from the collections of the Bibliothèque du Jardin botanique de Montréal).
Documents too damaged to be given away will be recycled.
No money is involved: the file is presented with no financial aspect.
The City had authorized a similar donation of 197 documents in May 2025.

The City is awarding a $143,701.34 contract (taxes included) to WAA Montréal inc. to design the work, prepare the construction documents and supervise shoreline restoration at parc-nature du Bois-de-Liesse.
A contingency budget of $21,555.20 is added, for a total expense of $165,256.54, paid entirely by the urban agglomeration.
The work covers two eroded shoreline sections totalling about 65 m, in the Péninsule sector of the parc-nature.
The mandate includes applying for ministerial authorization, providing support during the call for tenders for the work, and a one-year follow-up after construction.
WAA Montréal received the best score among 7 compliant bids; its price is 15% below the City's internal estimate.
The contract is part of the Programme de réhabilitation des berges (10 km in the large waterfront parks), to be completed by 2031 in order to keep the federal and provincial grants.
The firm's performance will be evaluated at the end of the contract.

The borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce is entrusting the Société environnementale de Côte-des-Neiges (SOCENV) with managing belongings left on the sidewalk during evictions, from January 1 to December 31, 2026.
Cost: $120,795.23 including taxes, plus a reserve of $20,535.25 if the number of evictions exceeds the 100 expected, for a maximum of $141,330.48.
SOCENV moves and stores the belongings for 60 days, tries to reach the evicted person and may extend the storage while they get organized.
Unclaimed belongings are sent to reuse organizations, ecocentres or other recovery channels; the borough estimates that 60% avoid landfill.
Payment is made in three instalments: 60% ($72,477.14) within 30 days of signing, 30% after the mid-term report in July, and 10% after the final report.
The expense is paid 100% out of the operating budget of the Direction des travaux publics, Voirie division.
The borough has managed this service since 2009, after the municipal pound closed; it recorded 215 evictions and 79 storage cases in 2025.
The City is adding $153,434.14 (taxes included) to the contract for supervising the work at parc du Bassin-à-Bois, in Le Sud-Ouest, awarded to Artelia Canada inc.
The total contract therefore goes from $1,764,492.59 to $1,917,926.73; the hourly rates set out in it do not change.
The work site, which started in May 2024, was supposed to be finished in August 2025, but will continue until June 2026, about 10 months behind schedule.

The reasons given: an area of contaminated soil twice as large as expected (97 days of extra time granted to the contractor), delays for corten steel and limestone, the electrical connection by Hydro-Québec, and the coordination of subcontractors.
The basic budget for the supervision contract was used up as of December 31, 2025, and the initial contingency funds will run out within a few months.
Supervision will continue until the final acceptance of the work, expected in June 2027, after the one-year warranty period.
The expense is paid by the central city, through the loan by-law for the development work in the Griffintown area.
Québec is giving $75,000 to the borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce to study the creation of a wetland on the site of the former hippodrome.

The money comes from the ministère de l'Environnement, de la Lutte contre les changements climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs, under the Programme de restauration et de création de milieux humides et hydriques.
The executive committee is being asked to add this $75,000 to the borough's operating revenues and expenses for 2026.
The studies are meant to confirm that the project is viable, connect it to the existing wetland, and factor climate risks into the planning of the future neighbourhood.
The land is in the Namur–De la Savane area, where 20,000 housing units are planned in the long run.

The borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce is paying $107,850 (taxes included where applicable) to the organization MultiCaf.
The money funds a temporary urban agriculture project on part of the former Hippodrome site and on the vegetable-garden roof of the bibliothèque de Côte-des-Neiges, from March 9 to December 30, 2026.
The funding comes from three sources: $87,000 from an assigned surplus from the 2023 local participatory budget, $10,850 from the unassigned surplus, and $10,000 from the 2026 operating budget.
The $10,000 goes specifically to farming activities on the library's vegetable-garden roof, which MultiCaf has maintained since 2024.
The fruits and vegetables grown are given to low-income people through MultiCaf's mobile solidarity market, solidarity grocery store and community cafeteria.
In 2025, the organization grew nearly 5,000 kg of vegetables on the site, the equivalent of $73K worth of vegetables.
This is an eighth consecutive year of farming on this land, pending phase 3 of the development of the Quartier Namur-Hippodrome.

The STM may limit or block access at any time, notably for operational constraints or emergencies, with prior written notice when the situation allows.

The STM cancelled its underground métro infrastructure project after new funding announcements and put the lot back up for sale; the green space project is therefore abandoned.
The new agreement applies to the use of the site starting in May 2026.
The borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce is paying $17,279.60 (taxes included) to Polliflora – Coopérative de Solidarité.

Polliflora manages and maintains four beehives, maintains the honey-plant plantings and the paths, and controls invasive plants.
All of the honey harvested goes to the Multicaf food bank; two harvests are planned, in July and in early September.
The site has a honey-plant meadow of about 250 m² and another planted area of 50 m² since 2022; activities there began in 2019.
The spending comes from the 2026 operating budget of the Direction de l'arrondissement devoted to the ecological transition.
In April 2025, the borough had granted $17,377.42 to the same organization for the same site.

CA26 25 0200.en: Tabling of the reports on the delegation of powers to officers and employees for the period from May 1 to 31, 2026 In accordance with section 477.2 of the Cities and Towns Act (chapter C-19), the treasurer has tabled the certificates attesting to the existence of sufficient appropriations for the purposes mentioned herein. Under section 130 of the Charter of Ville de Montréal, Metropolis of Québec (chapter C-11.4) and section 477.2 of the Cities and Towns Act (chapter C-19), a report on any decision made in relation to the delegated power must be tabled before the borough council at the first regular sitting held after the expiry of a 25-day period
CA26 25 0200.source: Dépôt des rapports de délégation de pouvoirs aux fonctionnaires et employés pour la période du 1er au 31 mai 2026 Conformément à l'article 477.2 de la Loi sur les cités et villes (chapitre C-19), le trésorier a déposé les certificats attestant l'existence des crédits suffisants aux fins mentionnées aux présentes. En vertu de l'article 130 de la Charte de la Ville de Montréal, métropole du Québec (chapitre C-11.4) et de l'article 477.2 de la Loi sur les cités et villes (chapitre C-19), il est requis de déposer au conseil d'arrondissement un rapport de toute décision prise relativement au pouvoir délégué, et ce à la première séance ordinaire tenue après l'expiration d'un délai de 25 jours

Present are: The borough mayor: Alan DeSousa The city councillors: Aref Salem Vana Nazarian - Absent The borough councillors: Jacques Cohen Annie Gagnier forming the quorum and sitting under the chairmanship of the borough mayor, Alan DeSousa, and in the presence of Me Julia Levitin, acting as secretary of the borough council. The borough mayor calls for a moment of reflection.
CA26 08 0001.source: Séance ordinaire du conseil d’arrondissement de Saint-Laurent est convoquée selon la loi et est tenue à la salle du conseil située au 777, boulevard Marcel-Laurin, Saint-Laurent, le mardi 6 janvier 2026, à 19 h 30. Cette séance est diffusée et disponible en ligne. Sont présents : Le maire d’arrondissement : Alan DeSousa Les conseillers de Ville : Aref Salem Vana Nazarian - Absente Les conseillers d’arrondissement : Jacques Cohen Annie Gagnier formant le quorum et siégeant sous la présidence du maire d’arrondissement, Alan DeSousa, et en présence de Me Julia Levitin, agissant à titre de secrétaire du conseil d’arrondissement. Le maire d’arrondissement demande un instant de recueillement.

CA26 08 0002.en: Submitted the agenda of the regular sitting of January 6, 2026. Moved by Councillor Jacques Cohen; Seconded by Councillor Annie Gagnier, it was UNANIMOUSLY RESOLVED: To adopt, as submitted, the agenda of the regular sitting of January 6, 2026. CARRIED.
CA26 08 0002.source: Soumis l'ordre du jour de la séance ordinaire du 6 janvier 2026. Proposé par le conseiller Jacques Cohen ; Appuyé par la conseillère Annie Gagnier, il est RÉSOLU À L'UNANIMITÉ : D'adopter, tel que soumis, l'ordre du jour de la séance ordinaire du 6 janvier 2026. ADOPTÉ.

CA26 08 0003.en: Submitted the minutes of the regular sitting of December 2, 2025. Moved by Councillor Jacques Cohen; Seconded by Councillor Annie Gagnier, it was UNANIMOUSLY RESOLVED: To adopt, as submitted, the minutes of the borough council's regular sitting of December 2, 2025. CARRIED.
CA26 08 0003.source: Soumis le procès-verbal de la séance ordinaire 2 décembre 2025. Proposé par le conseiller Jacques Cohen; Appuyé par la conseillère Annie Gagnier, il est RÉSOLU À L’UNANIMITÉ : D’adopter, tels que soumis, le procès-verbal de la séance ordinaire 2 décembre 2025 du conseil d’arrondissement. ADOPTÉ.

CA26 08 0008.en: Submitted decision summary number 1256275012 authorizing a one-year extension of the contract granted to the firm Sodem inc. for the management and operation services of the aquatic basins and the supervision of the sports facilities of the Complexe sportif de Saint-Laurent and covering the period from June 25, 2026 to June 24, 2027, for an estimated value of $1,697,369.52, taxes included, and indexed to the value of the CPI on the contract's anniversary date in 2026. CA26 08 0008.source: Soumis sommaire décisionnel numéro 1256275012 autorisant une année de prolongation du contrat octroyé à la firme Sodem inc. pour les services de gestion et d'exploitation des bassins aquatiques et la surveillance des plateaux sportifs du Complexe sportif de Saint-Laurent et couvrant la période du 25 juin 2026 au 24 juin 2027, d’une valeur estimée à 1 697 369,52 $ taxes incluses et indexée de la valeur de l'IPC à la date d’anniversaire du contrat en 2026. CE26 0675.en: Approve the premises loan extension agreement by which the Ville lends, free of charge, to Les Amis de la Montagne (Mont-Royal) inc., for an additional period of one year, as of May 1, 2026, premises N3, N5, N6, N7, N8, N13, N13.1 and N13.2 in the basement of the Chalet du Mont-Royal, located at 1196, chemin Camilien-Houde, in the borough of Ville-Marie, with an area of approximately 2,996.67 square feet, for office and storage purposes. The total amount of the real estate subsidy is estimated at $35,331.38
CE26 0675.source: Approuver la convention de prolongation de prêt de local par lequel la Ville prête, à titre gratuit, à Les Amis de la Montagne (Mont-Royal) inc., pour une période additionnelle d'un an, à compter du 1er mai 2026, les locaux N3, N5, N6, N7, N8, N13, N13.1 et N13.2 au sous-sol du Chalet du Mont-Royal, situé au 1196, chemin Camilien-Houde, dans l'arrondissement de Ville-Marie, d'une superficie d'environ 2 996,67 pieds carrés, à des fins de bureaux et d'entreposage. Le montant total de la subvention immobilière est estimé à 35 331,38 $

CE26 0676.en: Approve the 3rd lease amendment agreement by which the Ville leases from Développement Olymbec inc., for an additional term of 5 years, as of November 1, 2033, a space with an area of 138,865 square feet located at 8491-8525, rue Ernest-Cormier, in the borough of Anjou, for the needs of the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal - total expenditure of $15,319,578, taxes included / Approve the adjustment to the budget base of the Service de la stratégie immobilière et de l'habitation for 2033, in the amount of $431,298, and for 2034, in the amount of $2,156,490 / Approve the adjustment to the budget base of the Service de la gestion et de la planification des immeubles

CE26 0677.en: Approve the 4th lease amendment agreement by which the Ville leases from Aquakern inc., for an additional period of 5 years, as of August 1, 2026, office space located at 1625, rue de l'Église, in the borough of Verdun, with an area of 7,448 square feet, for neighbourhood station 15 of the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal, for a total rent of $1,275,937, taxes included
CE26 0677.source: Approuver la 4e convention de modification de bail par laquelle la Ville loue de Aquakern inc., pour une période additionnelle de 5 ans, à compter du 1er août 2026, un espace à bureaux situé au 1625, rue de l'Église, dans l'arrondissement de Verdun, d'une superficie de 7 448 pieds carrées, pour le poste de quartier 15 du Service de police de la Ville de Montréal, pour un loyer total de 1 275 937 $, taxes incluses

CE26 0679.en: territory - 1260469001 Grant financial support of $15,000 to Vivre en Ville, for the organization of the 10th edition of the Rendez-vous Collectivités viables, to be held on June 18, 2026 at the marché Bonsecours on the theme "S'adapter - Pour des communautés résilientes" / Approve the draft agreement to this effect
CE26 0679.source: territoire - 1260469001 Accorder un soutien financier de 15 000 $ à Vivre en Ville, pour l'organisation de la 10e édition du Rendez-vous Collectivités viables qui se tiendra le 18 juin 2026 au marché Bonsecours sur le thème « S'adapter - Pour des communautés résilientes » / Approuver le projet de convention à cet effet

CE26 0680.en: Grant financial support of $68,700 to the Regroupement des éco-quartiers, for the organization of the 22nd edition of the Patrouille verte, from June 1 to August 22, 2026 / Approve the draft agreement to this effect
CE26 0680.source: Accorder un soutien financier de 68 700 $ au Regroupement des éco-quartiers, pour l'organisation de la 22e édition de la Patrouille verte, du 1er juin au 22 août 2026 / Approuver le projet de convention à cet effet

CE26 0681.en: territory - 1264368002 Grant financial support of $12,500 to Vélo Québec Éditions, for the production and distribution of a map of the Greater Montréal bicycle network for the year 2026 / Approve the draft agreement to this effect
CE26 0681.source: territoire - 1264368002 Accorder un soutien financier de 12 500 $ à Vélo Québec Éditions, pour la production et la diffusion d'une carte du réseau cyclable du Grand Montréal pour l'année 2026 / Approuver le projet de convention à cet effet

CE26 0682.en: Councillor Andréanne Moreau declares her interest and abstains from taking part in the deliberations and from voting.

CE26 0683.en: - 1260418002 (ADDITION) Grant financial support of $65,000 to the Conseil des relations internationales de Montréal / Approve the draft agreement to this effect

CE26 0684.source: la gestion immobilière - 1264921002 Approuver l'addenda 2 au protocole d'entente, convenu entre la Ville et le ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation, dans le cadre du Programme d'infrastructures Municipalité amie des aînés, initialement dédiée au projet de remplacement du monte-personnes au Centre Monkland et transférée au projet d'aménagement d'une aire d'entraînement extérieure au parc Loyola

CE26 0685.en: Authorize the filing of an application for financial assistance under the Programme d'infrastructures municipales d'eau, component 2 - Water infrastructure, for the projects to reconstruct the collectors and interconnection chamber 1 at the usine Atwater and the project to upgrade the Côte-des-Neiges pumping station and reservoir
CE26 0685.source: Autoriser le dépôt d'une demande d'aide financière dans le cadre du Programme d'infrastructures municipales d'eau, volet 2 - Infrastructures d'eau, pour les projets de reconstruction des collecteurs et de la chambre d'interconnexion 1 à l'usine Atwater et du projet de mise à niveau de la station de pompage et du réservoir Côte-des-Neiges

CE26 0686.en: Approve addendum 4 to the memorandum of understanding between the ministère des Affaires municipales and the Ville, under the Major Projects component of the Fonds Chantiers Canada-Québec, for the project to control wastewater discharges during rainfall
CE26 0686.source: Approuver l'addenda 4 au protocole d'entente entre le ministère des Affaires municipales et la Ville, dans le cadre du volet Grands projets du Fonds Chantiers Canada-Québec pour le projet de contrôle des rejets d'eaux usées en temps de pluie

CE26 0688.source: Approuver le rapport « Plan de gestion des actifs municipaux en eau » de la Ville / Autoriser le dépôt du rapport au ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation

CE26 0689.en: Authorize an expenditure of $32,000 for the awarding of 9 bursaries to the winners and finalists of the 2026 edition of the Pierre-Ayot, Louis-Comtois and François-Houdé prizes, the Ville de Montréal's Awards of Excellence in Visual Arts and Fine Crafts
CE26 0689.source: Autoriser une dépense de 32 000 $ pour l'attribution de 9 bourses aux personnes lauréates et finalistes de l'édition 2026 des prix Pierre-Ayot, Louis-Comtois et François-Houdé, Prix d'excellence en arts visuels et en métiers d'art de la Ville de Montréal

CE26 0690.en: Amend the Ville's budget, in accordance with section 144 of the Charter of Ville de Montréal, Metropolis of Québec (CQLR, c. C-11.4), in order to take into account the receipt, by the borough of Outremont, of a financial contribution of $49,500 from the organization Sports et Loisirs de l'Île de Montréal, for the deployment of the equipment and material loan project of the Circonflexe program
CE26 0690.source: Modifier le budget de la Ville, en conformité avec l'article 144 de la Charte de la Ville de Montréal, métropole du Québec (RLRQ, c. C-11.4), afin de tenir compte de la réception, par l'arrondissement d'Outremont, d'une contribution financière de 49 500 $ provenant de l'organisme Sports et loisirs de l'Île de Montréal, pour le déploiement du projet de prêt de matériel et d'équipement du programme Circonflexe

CA26 14 0163.en: Grant a contract to Les industries Harnois inc., the lowest compliant bidder, for the supply and installation work for an urban greenhouse complex at parc Frédéric-Back, at the prices in its bid, for a maximum amount of $499,865.92, taxes included, and authorize a total expenditure of $574,845.80, taxes included (contingencies: $74,979.88) - public call for tenders VSP-26-IMM-22 (1 bidder)
CA26 14 0163.source: Octroyer un contrat à Les industries Harnois inc., plus bas soumissionnaire conforme, pour la fourniture et les travaux d’installation d’un complexe de serres urbaines au parc Frédéric-Back, aux prix de sa soumission, soit au montant maximal de 499 865,92 $, taxes incluses, et autoriser une dépense totale de 574 845,80 $, taxes incluses (contingences : 74 979,88 $) - appel d’offres public VSP-26-IMM-22 (1 soumissionnaire)

CA26 14 0164.en: Grant a contract to NAXO Construction (9220-9733 Québec inc.), the lowest compliant bidder, for the work to replace the cooling equipment at the bibliothèque de Saint-Michel, at the prices in its bid, for a maximum amount of $732,390.75, taxes included, and authorize a total expenditure of $871,425.99, taxes included (contingencies: $109,843.61; incidental expenses: $29,291.63) - public call for tenders VSP-26-IMM-07 (6 bidders).
CA26 14 0164.source: Octroyer un contrat à NAXO Construction (9220-9733 Québec inc.), plus bas soumissionnaire conforme, pour les travaux de remplacements des équipements de refroidissement à la bibliothèque de Saint-Michel, aux prix de sa soumission, soit au montant maximal de 732 390,75 $, taxes incluses et autoriser une dépense totale de 871 425,99 $, taxes incluses (contingences : 109 843,61 $ ; incidences : 29 291,63 $) - appel d’offres public VSP-26-IMM-07 (6 soumissionnaires).

CA26 14 0165.en: Grant a contract to Axe Construction inc., the lowest compliant bidder, for work to install guardrails and partially redevelop ice rink no. 1 at the aréna Saint-Michel, at the prices in its bid, for a maximum amount of $587,237.43, taxes included, and authorize a total expenditure of $692,923.04, taxes included (contingencies: $88,085.61; incidental expenses: $17,600) - public call for tenders VSP-26-IMM-03 (2 bidders).
CA26 14 0165.source: Octroyer un contrat à Axe Construction inc., plus bas soumissionnaire conforme, pour des travaux d’installation de garde-corps et réaménagement partiel de la glace no.1 de l’aréna Saint- Michel, aux prix de sa soumission, soit au montant maximal de 587 237,43 $, taxes incluses, et autoriser une dépense totale de 692 923,04 $, taxes incluses (contingences : 88 085,61 $ ; incidences : 17 600 $) - appel d’offres public VSP-26-IMM-03 (2 soumissionnaires).

CA26 14 0166.en: Approve a bilateral promise by which the Ville de Montréal undertakes to transfer by emphyteusis, for a term of 100 years, part of lot 2 245 347 of the cadastre du Québec, registration division of Montréal, to the organization Table de quartier de Parc-Extension, for the sole purpose of building and operating a community centre, under the conditions set out in the bilateral promise.
CA26 14 0166.source: Approuver une promesse bilatérale par laquelle la Ville de Montréal s’engage à céder par emphytéose, pour une durée de 100 ans, une partie du lot 2 245 347 du cadastre du Québec, circonscription foncière de Montréal, à l’organisme Table de quartier de Parc-Extension, et ce, aux seules fins de construire et exploiter un centre communautaire aux conditions édictées dans la promesse bilatérale.

CA26 14 0167.en: Grant a financial contribution of $25,000 to the Quartier des arts du cirque (QUAC), for the period from July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027, as part of the support for the organization's concerted development strategy, and approve the draft agreement to this end.
CA26 14 0167.source: Accorder une contribution financière de 25 000 $ au Quartier des arts du cirque (QUAC), pour la er période du 1 juillet 2026 au 30 juin 2027, dans le cadre du soutien à la stratégie de développement concertée de l’organisme, et approuver le projet de convention à cette fin.

CA26 14 0168.en: Grant a financial contribution of $12,000 to Loisirs Communautaires Saint-Michel from July to September 2026 for the implementation of activities promoting the adoption of cycling as part of the Activité Vélo 2026 project, drawn from the borough's surpluses, and approve the draft agreement to this end.
CA26 14 0168.source: Accorder une contribution financière de 12 000 $ aux Loisirs Communautaires Saint-Michel de juillet à septembre 2026 pour la mise en place d’activités favorisant l’adoption du vélo dans le cadre du projet Activité Vélo 2026 et à même les surplus de l’arrondissement et approuver le projet de convention à cette fin.

CA26 14 0169.en: Receive the consolidated reports setting out, for the period from May 1 to May 31, 2026, all the delegated decisions made by the borough in the exercise of its delegated powers, under By-law RCA18-14009.
CA26 14 0169.source: er Recevoir les rapports consolidés faisant état, pour la période du 1 mai au 31 mai 2026, de l’ensemble des décisions déléguées prises par l’arrondissement, dans l’exercice de ses pouvoirs délégués, en vertu du Règlement RCA18-14009.

CA26 14 0170.en: Authorize the payment of a total financial contribution of $9,000 to fourteen (14) organizations in the borough, drawn from the borough council's discretionary budget, for the 2026 fiscal year, as follows: $1,000 to the organization À portée de mains, $750 to the organization Carrefour de liaison et d'Aide multiethnique, $1,000 to the organization Carrefour populaire Saint-Michel, $250 to the organization Carrefour Communautaire Culturel de Séverine, $800 to the Centre socioéducatif Lasallien, $500 to the organization Maison de la Famille de Saint-Michel Inc., $1,250 to the organization Regroupement jeunesse en action, $150 to the Organisation des jeunes de Parc-Extension, $500 to the organization Himalaya
CA26 14 0170.source: Autoriser le versement d’une contribution financière totale de 9 000 $, à quatorze (14) organismes de l’arrondissement, à même le budget discrétionnaire du conseil d’arrondissement, pour l’année financière 2026, comme suit : 1 000 $ à l’organisme À portée de mains, 750 $ à l’organisme Carrefour de liaison et d’Aide multiethnique, 1 000 $ à l’organisme Carrefour populaire Saint- Michel, 250 $ à l’organisme Carrefour Communautaire Culturel de Séverine, 800 $ au Centre socioéducatif Lasallien, 500 $ à l’organisme Maison de la Famille de Saint-Michel Inc., 1 250 $ à l’organisme Regroupement jeunesse en action, 150 $ à l’Organisation des jeunes de Parc- Extension, 500 $ à l’Organisme Himalaya

CA26 14 0171.en: Take note of the filing of an application for financial assistance with the ministère de la Culture et des Communications as part of the call for projects in culture for the mental health of young people aged 12 to 18. This participatory cultural co-creation project aims to create a refuge space at the bibliothèque Saint-Michel and at the organization La Grande porte, by and for young people.
CA26 14 0171.source: Prendre acte du dépôt d’une demande d’aide financière auprès du ministère de la Culture et des Communications dans le cadre de l’appel de projets en culture pour la santé mentale des jeunes de 12 à 18 ans. Ce projet de cocréation culturelle participative vise l’aménagement d’un espace refuge à la bibliothèque Saint-Michel et à l’organisme La Grande porte, par et pour les jeunes.

CA26 14 0172.en: Authorize the filing of applications for financial assistance with the ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec (MTMD), under the Programme d'aide financière au Fonds de la sécurité routière (PAFFSR), for the acquisition of equipment, the construction of curb extensions and the construction of speed humps within the borough's territory.
CA26 14 0172.source: Autoriser le dépôt de demandes d’aide financière auprès du ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable du Québec (MTMD), dans le cadre du Programme d’aide financière au Fonds de la sécurité routière (PAFFSR), pour l’acquisition d’équipement, l’aménagement de saillies et la construction de dos d’âne sur le territoire de l’arrondissement.

CA26 14 0173.en: Ask the city council to increase the allocation of the arrondissement de Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension, through the environmental liability reserve, by an amount of $168,472.14, net of taxes, in order to cover all the environmental rehabilitation work as part of the execution of the development work at parc George-Vernot, land number 792, as well as the professional services fees for environmental monitoring following the redevelopment work.
CA26 14 0173.source: Demander au conseil municipal de majorer la dotation de l’arrondissement de Villeray–Saint- Michel–Parc-Extension, par l’entremise de la réserve du passif environnemental, pour un montant de 168 472,14 $, taxes nettes, afin de couvrir tous les travaux de réhabilitation environnementale dans le cadre de l’exécution des travaux d’aménagement du parc George-Vernot, terrain numéro 792, ainsi que les frais des services professionnels pour la surveillance environnementale suite aux travaux de réaménagement.

CA26 14 0174.en: Authorize a maximum expenditure of $500,000, drawn from the Borough's surpluses, in order to continue asset management efforts, of which an amount of $300,000 is allocated to tree maintenance work and an amount of $200,000 to minor roadway repair work.
CA26 14 0174.source: Autoriser une dépense maximale de 500 000 $, à même les surplus de l’Arrondissement, afin de poursuivre les efforts en matière de gestion des actifs dont un montant de 300 000 $ est affecté aux travaux d’entretien arboricole et un montant de 200 000 $ aux travaux mineurs de réparation de la chaussée.

CA26 14 0175.en: Enact the ordinances for the programming of public events within the borough's territory for the months of July to December 2026.
CA26 14 0175.source: Édicter les ordonnances pour la programmation d’événements publics sur le territoire de l’arrondissement pour les mois de juillet à décembre 2026.

CA26 14 0176.en: Enact an ordinance determining the temporary closure to vehicular traffic of rue Boyer between rue Villeray Est and rue du Rosaire and adjacent to école primaire Marie-Favery, under section 3, paragraph 3, of the By-law concerning traffic and parking in the arrondissement de Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension (R.R.V.M., chapter C-4.1).
CA26 14 0176.source: Édicter une ordonnance déterminant la fermeture temporaire à la circulation véhiculaire de la rue Boyer entre la rue Villeray Est et la rue du Rosaire et adjacente à l’école primaire Marie-Favery, en vertu de l’article 3, alinéa 3, du Règlement sur la circulation et le stationnement à l’égard de l’arrondissement de Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension (R.R.V.M., chapitre C-4.1).

CA26 14 0177.en: Enact an ordinance for the installation of a pedestrian crossing at the east approach of the intersection of rue De Castelnau Est and rue De Lanaudière (west branch), and the installation of stop signs at the intersection of rue De Castelnau Est and rue Rousselot, under section 3, paragraphs 1 and 3, of the By-law concerning traffic and parking in the arrondissement de Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension (R.R.V.M., chapter C-4.1).
CA26 14 0177.source: Édicter une ordonnance visant l’aménagement d’un passage pour personnes à l’approche est de l’intersection de la rue De Castelnau Est et de la rue De Lanaudière (branche ouest), et l’installation de panneaux d’arrêt à l’intersection de la rue De Castelnau Est et de la rue Rousselot, en vertu de l’article 3, alinéas 1 et 3, du Règlement sur la circulation et le stationnement à l’égard de l’arrondissement de Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension (R.R.V.M., chapitre C-4.1).

CA26 14 0178.en: Enact an ordinance for the installation of a pedestrian crossing at the north approach of the intersection of 25e Avenue and boulevard Provencher, as well as the replacement of the southbound stop sign with yield signage, under section 3, paragraphs 1 and 3, of the By-law concerning traffic and parking in the arrondissement de Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension (R.R.V.M., chapter C-4.1).
CA26 14 0178.source: Édicter une ordonnance visant l’aménagement d’un passage pour personnes à l’approche nord de e l’intersection de la 25 Avenue et du boulevard Provencher, ainsi que le remplacement de l’arrêt en direction sud par une signalisation de céder le passage, en vertu de l’article 3, alinéas 1 et 3, du Règlement sur la circulation et le stationnement à l’égard de l’arrondissement de Villeray– Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension (R.R.V.M., chapitre C-4.1).

CA26 14 0179.en: Enact an ordinance for the creation of a mural on the wall of the building located at 7909, rue Berri, which will be visible from the public domain, as part of the Programme des ruelles vertes and under section 36 of the By-law concerning cleanliness and civic responsibility (RCA08-14005).
CA26 14 0179.source: Édicter une ordonnance pour la réalisation d’une murale sur le mur du bâtiment situé au 7909, rue Berri, qui sera visible du domaine public dans le cadre du Programme des ruelles vertes et en vertu de l’article 36 du Règlement sur la propreté et le civisme (RCA08-14005).

CA26 14 0180.en: Enact an ordinance to authorize the Banque Nationale to temporarily install an advertising element on the façade of the building located at 8091, rue Saint-Denis for the period from July 13 to August 23, 2026, under section 516 of the zoning by-law of the arrondissement de Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension (01-283).
CA26 14 0180.source: Édicter une ordonnance afin d’autoriser la Banque Nationale d’installer temporairement un élément publicitaire sur la façade du bâtiment situé au 8091, rue Saint-Denis pour la période du 13 juillet au 23 août 2026 en vertu de l’article 516 du règlement de zonage de l’arrondissement de Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension (01-283).

CA26 14 0181.en: Enact an ordinance to authorize the establishment of a solidarity market in parc Nicolas-Tillemont (lot 2 166 840), under section 13 of the By-law concerning public markets (R.R.V.M., chapter M-2).
CA26 14 0181.source: Édicter une ordonnance afin d’autoriser l’établissement d’un marché solidaire dans le parc Nicolas-Tillemont (lot 2 166 840), en vertu de l’article 13 du Règlement sur les marchés publics (R.R.V.M., chapitre M-2).

CA26 14 0182.en: Adopt By-law 01-283-128 entitled "By-law amending the zoning by-law of the arrondissement de Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension (01-283)" in order to authorize the installation of temporary signs during the redevelopment work on rue De Castelnau Est, and receive the minutes of the public consultation meeting held on June 11, 2026.

CA26 27 0108.en: Award a contract of $1,063,285.35, taxes included, to Groupe ABF inc. for minor sidewalk rehabilitation and geometric redevelopment work on various streets (RMT-2026), in accordance with the documents of call for tenders 2026-002-P, and authorize a total expenditure of $1,317,228.85, taxes included. Allocate an amount of $38,000 from the borough surplus to the project in order to fund the work on the arterial network.
CA26 27 0108.source: Attribuer à Groupe ABF inc. un contrat de 1 063 285,35 $, taxes incluses, pour des travaux de réfection mineure de trottoirs et de réaménagement géométrique sur les différentes rues (RMT- 2026), conformément aux documents de l'appel d'offres 2026-002-P et autoriser une dépense totale de 1 317 228,85 $, taxes incluses. Affecter une somme de 38 000 $ du surplus d'arrondissement au projet afin de financer les travaux sur le réseau artériel.

CA26 27 0109.en: Enter into a 2-year blanket contract for professional services with IGF Axiom inc. for the management and supervision of construction contracts on various streets, for a maximum amount of $552,454.88, taxes included, in accordance with the documents of public call for tenders 2026-005-P.
CA26 27 0109.source: Conclure un contrat-cadre de services professionnels avec IGF Axiom inc., d'une durée de 2 ans, pour la gestion et la surveillance des contrats de construction sur les diverses rues, pour un montant maximal de 552 454,88 $, taxes incluses, conformément aux documents de l'appel d'offres public 2026-005-P.

CA26 27 0110.en: Approve the submission of an application for financial assistance to the ministère de l'Éducation, under the Programme d'aide financière aux infrastructures récréatives, sportives et de plein air, for the project to bring the piscine Pierre-Lorange up to standard as well as the expansion and conversion of the bibliothèque Hochelaga into a community and sports centre.
CA26 27 0110.source: Approuver la présentation d'une demande d'aide financière au ministère de l'Éducation, dans le cadre du Programme d'aide financière aux infrastructures récréatives, sportives et de plein air, pour le projet de mise aux normes de la piscine Pierre-Lorange ainsi que l'agrandissement et la transformation de la bibliothèque Hochelaga en centre communautaire et sportif.

CA26 27 0111.en: Allocate an amount of $15,142.41 from the borough surplus in order to transfer the residual 2025 funds of the grant Soutien à la création et à la consolidation d'espaces jeunesse montréalais 2022-2026, offered by the ministère de la Sécurité publique in Québec, in order to comply with the ministère's directions regarding the use of the funds received.
CA26 27 0111.source: Affecter une somme de 15 142,41 $ du surplus de l'arrondissement afin de transférer les fonds résiduels de l'année 2025 de la subvention Soutien à la création et à la consolidation d'espaces jeunesse montréalais 2022-2026, proposée par le ministère de la Sécurité publique au Québec afin de respecter les orientations du ministère en ce qui concerne l'utilisation des fonds reçus.

CA26 27 0112.en: Offer to the borough of Anjou, under section 85.1 of the Charter of Ville de Montréal, Metropolis of Québec (CQLR, c. C-11.4), to assume responsibility for the roadway repair work on rue Robitaille, for the section between rue Des Ormeaux and the boundary of that borough.
CA26 27 0112.source: Offrir à l'arrondissement d'Anjou, en vertu de l'article 85.1 de la Charte de la Ville de Montréal, métropole du Québec (RLRQ, c. C-11.4), de prendre en charge les travaux de réparation de la chaussée sur la rue Robitaille, pour le tronçon compris entre la rue Des Ormeaux et la limite de cet arrondissement.

CA26 27 0113.en: Offer to the city council, under the second paragraph of section 85 of the Charter of Ville de Montréal, Metropolis of Québec (CQLR, c. C-11.4), to assume responsibility for the preparation of the plans and specifications, the call for tenders process, the awarding of the contract as well as the carrying out and supervision of all the roadway repair work on avenue Souligny, which is part of the borough's arterial network.
CA26 27 0113.source: Offrir au conseil municipal, en vertu du deuxième alinéa de l'article 85 de la Charte de la Ville de Montréal, métropole du Québec (RLRQ, c. C-11.4), de prendre en charge l'élaboration des plans et devis, le processus d'appel d'offres, l'attribution du contrat ainsi que la réalisation et la surveillance de l'ensemble des travaux de réparation de la chaussée sur l'avenue Souligny, faisant partie du réseau artériel de l'arrondissement.

CA26 27 0114.en: Adopt the By-law respecting the specific occupancy of the public domain for the purpose of using parc Champêtre for sports activities dedicated primarily and as a priority to soccer on lot 2 775 108 of the cadastre du Québec (RCA25-27009).
CA26 27 0114.source: Adopter le Règlement particulier d'occupation du domaine public aux fins d'utilisation du parc Champêtre pour la pratique sportive dédiée principalement et prioritairement au soccer sur le lot 2 775 108 du cadastre du Québec (RCA25-27009).

CA26 27 0115.en: Enact ordinances permitting the closure of the street to motor vehicle traffic, noise from sound equipment broadcasting outdoors, the consumption and sale of food and of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, the sale of items, signage and the expansion of sidewalk cafés as part of the pedestrianization event on rue Ontario Est, from June 15 to September 18, 2026.
CA26 27 0115.source: Édicter des ordonnances permettant la fermeture de la rue à la circulation automobile, le bruit d'appareils sonores diffusant à l'extérieur, la consommation et la vente de nourriture et de boissons alcooliques ou non, la vente d'articles, l'affichage et l'agrandissement des café- terrasses dans le cadre de l'événement de la piétonnisation de la rue Ontario Est, du 15 juin au 18 septembre 2026.

CA26 27 0116.en: Enact ordinances permitting noise from sound equipment broadcasting outdoors, the closure of streets, the consumption and sale of food and of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages and the sale of promotional items related to the events.
CA26 27 0116.source: Édicter des ordonnances permettant le bruit d'appareils sonores diffusant à l'extérieur, la fermeture de rues, la consommation et la vente de nourriture et de boissons alcooliques ou non et la vente d'articles promotionnels reliés aux événements.

CA26 27 0118.source: Édicter une ordonnance établissant la mise à sens unique de l'avenue Desjardins, en direction sud, entre les rues La Fontaine et Adam.

CA26 27 0119.en: Authorize the temporary removal of 113 paid parking spaces as part of the summer pedestrianization of rue Ontario Est.
CA26 27 0119.source: Autoriser le retrait temporaire de 113 places de stationnement tarifées dans le cadre de la piétonnisation estivale de la rue Ontario Est.

CA26 27 0124.en: Adopt the draft resolution authorizing the demolition of the two industrial buildings located at 2115, rue Théodore and 2150, rue Saint-Clément and the construction of two residential buildings on two separate lots, under section 93 of the Act to amend various legislative provisions with respect to housing (S.Q. 2024, c. 2).

CA26 27 0125.en: Adopt the draft resolution authorizing the modification of the uses on the ground floor of the building of phase 3 (former phase 4) and the access lanes of phases 1 and 2 of the Canoë project (lot 1 879 326), under section 93 of the Act to amend various legislative provisions with respect to housing (S.Q. 2024, c. 2).

CA26 27 0141.en: Award to Patriarche Architecture inc. a professional services contract of $2,065,921.39, taxes included, for the preparation of plans and specifications as well as site supervision for the project to bring the piscine Pierre-Lorange up to standard and to expand and convert the bibliothèque Hochelaga into a community centre, in accordance with the documents of public call for tenders 2026-012-P, and authorize a total expenditure of $2,685,697.81, taxes included.
CA26 27 0141.source: Attribuer à Patriarche Architecture inc. un contrat de services professionnels de 2 065 921,39 $, taxes incluses, pour la réalisation des plans et des devis ainsi que la surveillance de chantier pour le projet de la mise aux normes de la piscine Pierre-Lorange et l'agrandissement et la transformation de la bibliothèque Hochelaga en centre communautaire, conformément aux documents de l'appel d'offres public 2026-012-P et autoriser une dépense totale de 2 685 697,81 $, taxes incluses.

CA26 27 0142.en: Set the location of the regular meeting of the borough council of June 29, 2026 at 6 p.m. at parc Carlos-d'Alcantara, cancel the regular meeting of the month of August and change the date of the regular meeting of October 5 to October 14, 2026.
CA26 27 0142.source: Fixer le lieu de la séance ordinaire du conseil d'arrondissement du 29 juin 2026 à 18 h, au parc Carlos-d'Alcantara, annuler la séance ordinaire du mois d'août et modifier la date de la séance ordinaire du 5 octobre pour le 14 octobre 2026.

CA26 27 0143.en: Authorize a budget transfer in the amount of $12,632.40, from the operating budget of the Bureau de l'aménagement des parcs et actifs immobiliers to the budget of the Service de la gestion et de la planification des immeubles (SGPI) for the year 2026 in order to pay for various services complementary to the SGPI's offer.
CA26 27 0143.source: Autoriser un virement budgétaire au montant de 12 632,40 $, en provenance du budget de fonctionnement du Bureau de l'aménagement des parcs et actifs immobiliers vers le budget du Service de la gestion et de la planification des immeubles (SGPI) pour l'année 2026 afin de payer divers services complémentaires à l'offre du SGPI.

CA26 27 0144.en: Support the projects of the écoles Saint-Clément and Sainte-Claire of the Centre de services scolaire de Montréal described in this decision summary so that they may submit an application for financial assistance to the ministère de l'Éducation under the Programme d'aide financière aux infrastructures récréatives, sportives et de plein air (PAFIRSPA), and undertake to conclude a facility-sharing agreement or to continue an existing agreement already concluded with the facilities concerned in order to promote accessibility for the entire population.
CA26 27 0144.source: Appuyer les projets des écoles Saint-Clément et Sainte-Claire du Centre de services scolaire de Montréal décrits dans le présent sommaire afin que ces derniers puissent soumettre une demande d'aide financière au ministère de l'Éducation dans le cadre du Programme d'aide financière aux infrastructures récréatives, sportives et de plein air (PAFIRSPA) et de s'engager à conclure une entente de partage des installations ou de poursuivre une entente existante déjà conclue avec les installations visées pour favoriser l'accessibilité à l'ensemble de la population.

CA26 09 0020.en: Enact, under the By-law concerning traffic and parking (R.R.V.M., c. C-4.1), an ordinance to establish and remove bus stops for the Société de Transport de Montréal (STM) throughout the territory of the borough of Ahuntsic-Cartierville, as part of the bus network overhaul.
CA26 09 0020.source: Édicter, en vertu du Règlement sur la circulation et le stationnement (R.R.V.M., c. C-4.1), une ordonnance visant à établir et à retirer des postes d'attente pour les autobus de la Société de Transport de Montréal (STM) sur l'ensemble du territoire de l'arrondissement d'Ahuntsic- Cartierville, dans le cadre de la refonte du réseau d'autobus.

CA26 09 0021.en: Adopt, with amendment, the By-law amending the zoning by-law of the borough of Ahuntsic-Cartierville (01-274), in order to ensure its consistency with provision 8.2 of the complementary document of the Ville de Montréal's Urban Planning and Mobility Plan, as well as other provisions concerning the planting, maintenance, protection and felling of trees.
CA26 09 0021.source: Adopter, avec changement, le Règlement modifiant le règlement d'urbanisme de l'arrondissement d'Ahuntsic-Cartierville (01-274), afin d'assurer sa concordance avec la disposition 8.2 du document complémentaire du Plan d'urbanisme et de mobilité de la Ville de Montréal, ainsi que d'autres dispositions relatives à la plantation, l'entretien, la protection et l'abattage des arbres.

CA26 09 0022.en: Adopt the By-law amending the Zoning By-law of the borough of Ahuntsic-Cartierville (01-274) and the By-law concerning fences (R.R.V.M., c. C-5) of the former Ville de Montréal with respect to the territory of the borough of Ahuntsic-Cartierville, in order to provide clarifications regarding pool and hot tub enclosures, in particular concerning the distance between a fence and a pool, as well as the requirements for locking hot tubs. 13

C-5) de l'ancienne Ville de Montréal à l'égard du territoire de l'arrondissement d'Ahuntsic-Cartierville, afin d'apporter des précisions quant aux enceintes de piscines et de bains à remous, notamment en ce qui concerne la distance entre une clôture et une piscine, ainsi que les exigences relatives au verrouillage des bains à remous. 13

CA26 09 0026.en: Request that the Directeur de l'état civil designate Madame Maude Théroux-Séguin, mayor of the borough of Ahuntsic-Cartierville, as well as Monsieur Victor Esposito, councillor for the district of Saint-Sulpice, as competent officiants, in order to solemnize civil unions and marriages within the territory of the borough.

Le montant de la subvention immobilière est de 57 076 $

CG26 0070.en: Adopt the accompanying document to By-law RCG 14-029-8 amending the Schéma d'aménagement et de développement de l'agglomération de Montréal (RCG 14-029)
CG26 0070.source: Adopter le document d'accompagnement du Règlement RCG 14-029-8 modifiant le Schéma d'aménagement et de développement de l'agglomération de Montréal (RCG 14-029)

CG26 0071.en: Approve the compliance with the objectives of the Schéma d'aménagement et de développement de l'agglomération de Montréal of the Hydro-Québec project for the construction of a new 315 kilovolt underground line between the postes des Irlandais and Guy, on the territory of the Ville de Montréal, in the boroughs of Le Sud-Ouest and Ville-Marie

CG26 0072.en: Notice of motion and tabling - By-law authorizing a loan of $1,200,000 to finance the work on cycling facilities as part of phase two of the avenue des Pins redevelopment project NOTICE OF MOTION AND TABLING OF A DRAFT BY-LAW Notice of motion is given by Mr. Dimitrios (Jim) Beis that the draft by-law entitled "By-law authorizing a loan of $1,200,000 to finance the work on cycling facilities as part of phase two of the avenue des Pins redevelopment project" will be placed on the agenda for adoption at a subsequent meeting of the agglomeration council, which draft by-law is tabled with the decision-making file.
CG26 0072.source: Avis de motion et dépôt - Règlement autorisant un emprunt de 1 200 000 $ pour financer les travaux des aménagements cyclables dans le cadre de la phase deux du projet de réaménagement de l'avenue des Pins AVIS DE MOTION ET DÉPÔT D’UN PROJET DE RÈGLEMENT Avis de motion est donné par M. Dimitrios (Jim) Beis de l’inscription pour adoption à une assemblée subséquente du conseil d’agglomération du projet de règlement intitulé « Règlement autorisant un emprunt de 1 200 000 $ pour financer les travaux des aménagements cyclables dans le cadre de la phase deux du projet de réaménagement de l'avenue des Pins », lequel est déposé avec le dossier décisionnel.

CG26 0073.source: Adoption - Règlement autorisant un emprunt de 10 880 000 $ afin de financer l'acquisition et le remplacement d'équipements spécialisés liés à la sécurité publique pour le Service de police de la Ville de Montréal

CG26 0074.en: Adoption - By-law amending the Règlement du conseil d'agglomération sur la définition de l'aide à l'entreprise (RCG 06-019)

C-11.4), to take charge of the design, coordination and execution of the minor sidewalk repair (RMT) work on certain streets of the City's administrative arterial road network (RAAV), located in the territory of the borough of Montréal-Nord, as part of the 2026 Road Infrastructure Maintenance Program (PMIR)

C-11.4), de prendre en charge la conception, la coordination et la réalisation des travaux de réfection mineure des trottoirs (RMT) sur certaines rues du réseau artériel administratif de la Ville (RAAV), localisés sur le territoire de l'arrondissement Montréal-Nord, dans le cadre du Programme de maintien des infrastructures routières (PMIR) 2026

CA26 08 0031.en: The regular sitting of the borough council of Saint-Laurent is convened in accordance with the law and is held in the council chamber located at 777, boulevard Marcel-Laurin, Saint-Laurent, on Tuesday, February 3, 2026, at 7:30 p.m. This sitting is broadcast and available online. Present are: The borough mayor: Alan DeSousa The city councillors: Aref Salem Vana Nazarian The borough councillors: Jacques Cohen Annie Gagnier constituting a quorum and sitting under the chairmanship of the borough mayor, Alan DeSousa, and in the presence of Me Julia Levitin, acting as secretary of the borough council. The borough mayor calls for a moment of reflection.
CA26 08 0031.source: Séance ordinaire du conseil d’arrondissement de Saint-Laurent est convoquée selon la loi et est tenue à la salle du conseil située au 777, boulevard Marcel-Laurin, Saint-Laurent, le mardi 3 février 2026, à 19 h 30. Cette séance est diffusée et disponible en ligne. Sont présents : Le maire d’arrondissement : Alan DeSousa Les conseillers de Ville : Aref Salem Vana Nazarian Les conseillers d’arrondissement : Jacques Cohen Annie Gagnier formant le quorum et siégeant sous la présidence du maire d’arrondissement, Alan DeSousa, et en présence de Me Julia Levitin, agissant à titre de secrétaire du conseil d’arrondissement. Le maire d’arrondissement demande un instant de recueillement.

CA26 08 0032.en: Submitted: the agenda of the regular sitting of February 3, 2026. Moved by Jacques Cohen; Seconded by Annie Gagnier, it is UNANIMOUSLY RESOLVED: To adopt, as submitted, the agenda of the regular sitting of February 3, 2026. ADOPTED.
CA26 08 0032.source: Soumis l'ordre du jour de la séance ordinaire du 3 février 2026. Proposé par Jacques Cohen; Appuyé par Annie Gagnier, il est RÉSOLU À L'UNANIMITÉ : D'adopter, tel que soumis, l'ordre du jour de la séance ordinaire du 3 février 2026. ADOPTÉ.

CA26 08 0033.en: Submitted: the minutes of the regular sitting of January 6, 2026. Moved by Jacques Cohen; Seconded by Annie Gagnier, it is UNANIMOUSLY RESOLVED: To adopt, as submitted, the minutes of the regular sitting of January 6, 2026 of the borough council. ADOPTED.

CM26 0702.en: Increase the 2026 operating budget of the Service de l'urbanisme et de la mobilité, through the environmental liability for contaminated soils, by an additional net budget of $388,954.57, in order to fund an environmental and geotechnical characterization study planned as part of the preparation of the plans and specifications for the Parc d'entreprises de la Pointe-Saint-Charles - Bonaventure project

CM26 0706.en: Accept the offer of services from the borough of Ville-Marie to take charge of the design and execution of several maintenance and development works in the Quartier des spectacles, in accordance with section 85 of the Charter of Ville de Montréal, Metropolis of Québec (CQLR, c. CM26 0707.en: Authorize the reallocation of the $5,000,000 balance of the Reserve Fund for innovative projects, established under the agreement between the Agence de mobilité durable and the Ville, for the 2020-2024 period (CM19 1364), in order to integrate it into the Operating Reserve Fund provided for in the current agreement between the two parties (CM25 1008) / Allow the use of the balance as of the coming into force of this new agreement

CM26 0711.en: Accept the offer of services from the borough of Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce, in accordance with section 85 of the Charter of Ville de Montréal, Metropolis of Québec (CQLR, c. C-11.4), to take charge of the design and execution of the roadway rehabilitation work on the Ville's administrative arterial network, in view of the holding of the 2026 UCI Road World Championships

C-11.4), falling within the jurisdiction of the city council, namely June 6, 2024 / Accept the forthcoming offer from this borough council to take charge of the Maison Nivard-De Saint-Dizier, in accordance with section 85 of the Charter of Ville de Montréal, Metropolis of Québec (CQLR, c. C-11.4)

C-11.4)

CA26 14 0079.source: er Recevoir les rapports consolidés faisant état, pour la période du 1 février au 28 février 2026, de l'ensemble des décisions déléguées prises par l'Arrondissement, dans l'exercice de ses pouvoirs délégués, en vertu du Règlement RCA18-14009.

CA26 14 0080.en: Authorize the payment of a total financial contribution of $3,300 to four (4) organizations in the Borough, from the borough council's discretionary budget, for the 2026 fiscal year, as follows: $1,500 to Fonds 1804 pour la persévérance scolaire; $800 to Saint-Michel Vie Sans Frontières; $500 to Centre Femmes Convictions de Montréal; $500 to Regroupement Jeunesse en Action, all for various activities.

CA26 14 0081.en: Accept, under section 85.1 of the Charter of Ville de Montréal, Metropolis of Québec (CQLR, c. C-11.4), the offer of the borough of Ville-Marie to take charge of providing the services of a dedicated public works team to support the other boroughs of Ville de Montréal with issues related to homelessness, for a period of 12 months beginning in spring 2026.

C 11.4), l'offre de l'arrondissement de Ville-Marie de prendre en charge l'offre de services d'une équipe de travaux publics dédiée en soutien aux enjeux liés à l'itinérance aux autres arrondissements de la Ville de Montréal, pour une période de 12 mois débutant au printemps 2026.

C-11.4), to take charge of the design, coordination and execution of the rehabilitation work on sections of the REV Lajeunesse within the territory of the borough of Villeray–Saint-Michel–Parc-Extension.

CE26 0475.en: By-law RCE 26-002 ____________________________ CE26 0268 The study of this file took place in camera. It is RESOLVED: 1 - to approve the administrative reorganization of the Ville de Montréal; 19/21 Regular meeting of the executive committee of Wednesday, February 11, 2026 at 9:20 a.m. 2 - to authorize the director general to ensure the implementation of the reorganization no later than April 20, 2026, subject to the adoption of the new Règlement sur les services by the city council; 3 - to place on the agenda of the city council, for notice of motion and tabling, the draft by-law entitled "Règlement sur les services", and to recommend its adoption at a subsequent meeting.
CE26 0475.source: Règlement RCE 26-002 ____________________________ CE26 0268 L'étude de ce dossier s'est déroulée à huis clos. Il est RÉSOLU : 1 - d'approuver la réorganisation administrative de la Ville de Montréal; 19/21 Séance ordinaire du comité exécutif du mercredi 11 février 2026 à 9 h 20 2 - d'autoriser le directeur général à assurer la mise en place de la réorganisation au plus tard le 20 avril 2026, sous réserve de l’adoption du nouveau Règlement sur les services par le conseil municipal; 3 - d'inscrire à l’ordre du jour du conseil municipal, pour avis de motion et dépôt, le projet de règlement intitulé « Règlement sur les services », et d’en recommander l’adoption à une assemblée subséquente.

CA26 26 0112.en: Give notice of motion, present and file a draft by-law entitled « Règlement sur le traitement des membres du conseil d'arrondissement de Rosemont–La Petite-Patrie », in order to establish the additional remuneration for the chairmanship of the comité consultatif d'urbanisme, the function of acting borough mayor and participation in certain committees. The borough mayor, Mr. François Limoges, gives notice of motion that at the next ordinary sitting or any subsequent ordinary sitting, a by-law entitled « Règlement sur le traitement des membres du conseil d'arrondissement de Rosemont–La Petite-Patrie » (RCA-206) will be adopted in order to establish the remuneration
